P_0x00EBCC: Alteur Steinbeck's true identity. A member of an alien faction called the "Ze Balmar Empire Inspection Army"; he once dropped <Meteor 3> on Earth and sent the automated planet Nebulaseem into the solar system.
P_0x00ECE9: Chief strategist of the Feil Army. A capable man, though a bit of a nag.
P_0x00ED4C: High priest of the Holy Kingdom of Langran, who gave the coronation address.
P_0x00EDB6: Commander of the <Earth Fed Army>'s 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron. Rare among space force officers for having become a captain despite being Earth-born. Disapproves of specialized units like the Steel Dragon Squadron.
P_0x00EEB5: Marshal of the <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist who sees the big picture and accepts both good and ill. Dry personality, but loves sake and his grandchildren dearly.
P_0x00EF62: Chairman of the <Earth Fed Army> Joint Chiefs of Staff, ranked General. Gaspard's right-hand man. Cautious and bureaucratic by nature, which put him at odds with the pragmatic Norman Sley, founder of the Earth Sphere Defense Committee.
